kartId.description: The kart the run was raced in (kart.schema.json karts id; Classic and Buggy allowed: a twin gains nothing). The server replays the log in this kart, so the same log claimed in another kart replays to another time and is refused. Stored as kart_id; rows from before 26 Sept 2026 have none (null): they were raced in what is now the racer's own kart, which handles the same, and show as it.

inputLog.description: Compressed input log; server re-simulates to verify timeMs

verified.description: Set by the Edge Function only
